estimates.anchor_source: none: no market on European STR regulation (Polymarket public-search 2026-09-17T08:21:26Z; Kalshi/Metaculus none per the 5 Sep 2026 regulatory note)
estimates.base_rate_construction: 6 qualifying enactments in the trailing 24 months (4 clear + 2 marginal) x 4.8/24 months = lambda 1.2; strict 0.55, lenient 0.93
estimates.decomposition_construction: 1 - (1-0.18 Greece gated)(1-0.15 Spain national)(1-0.30 Spain regional)(1-0.12 Paris)(1-0.12 Italy)(1-0.10 England)(1-0.05 Portugal)(1-0.10 other)(1-0.01 EU act)

conventions: restriction = binding cap/ban/moratorium/licence non-renewal/registration-with-removal/principal-residence rule; taxes, data sharing, standards, fines excluded
enacted = adopted by the competent body between 17 Sep 2026 and 11 Feb 2027, or taking effect in the window; proposals excluded
a freeze extension by new decision counts as enacted anew

gate: national measures in FR/ES/IT/DE/EL/PT/PL/HR/AT/UK, Paris, London, Rome, Canary Islands qualify; Athens-only, Ireland, Amsterdam, Lisbon, Madrid, Barcelona, Florence do not (EU27 share x 0.8, team exposure anchors)

impact.note: modal event = mid-sized enactment, register loss mode 0.10-0.20% of revenue, mostly after Jun 2027; stock -$0.7 fundamental plus -1% headline drift (0 of 41 moves >=7% regulatory); tail (Spanish mass removal or Paris professional ban, P~0.20) -$5/share; material only because likely, not because large; quote as one line

sensitivity.assumption: resolver requires a measure of the exemplified magnitude (licence withdrawal, national registry with removals, EU caps)
resolver accepts national instruments regardless of affected-city size (Greek extension, Irish register count)
freeze extensions do not count as enacted
Spanish replacement registry bill tabled by November (0.15 -> 0.30)
European events correlated (rho 0.45) rather than independent
